contact_route: Meetup 'Message' link to the organizers on meetup.com/foreigners-in-seoul (no public email/phone).
hooks: Meetup page: 8,658 members; Saturday events 18:45-01:00 at MCJUCHANGO (2F), near Yeoksam Station exit 4, Gangnam (meetup.com/foreigners-in-seoul).
Page asks members to be respectful to host and bar staff; no explicit rule on promotion found -> ask organizer before sharing.
Map covers the Gangnam-Yeoksam strip, a short walk from the venue.

list.title: Gangnam after the meetup
list.desc: A free starter map made by PinWith for FOREIGNERS IN SEOUL! members: coffee, Korean BBQ, chimaek, noraebang and dessert around Gangnam Station. Share it with your table and co-edit.

items.title: Gangnam Station (강남역)
items.memo: Line 2 and Shinbundang Line; 12 exits, check yours; Yeoksam is one stop east

items.title: Dwaeji Sanghoe (돼지상회)
items.memo: All-you-can-eat pork BBQ sets; 2nd floor, up a short hill

items.title: BBQ YUL
items.memo: Pork BBQ grilled by staff; English menu; closed Sundays

items.title: Damongjib Sinnonhyeon (다몽집)
items.memo: Pork BBQ cooked for you; open until 05:00 most nights

items.title: Oneul Tongdak Gangnam (오늘통닭)
items.memo: Large chicken pub, tablet ordering; good for groups

items.title: Kyochon Chicken Gangnam Station
items.memo: Honey-garlic chicken; tablet ordering; open until 05:00

items.title: Superstar Coin Noraebang (슈퍼스타코인노래연습장)
items.memo: Coin karaoke, 3 songs per ₩1,000; expect a wait after 18:00

items.title: Samsam Coin Noraebang (삼삼코인노래연습장)
items.memo: Coin karaoke in basement 2 on Gangnam-daero; open until 02:00

items.title: Selected Nick's Gangnam
items.memo: Multi-floor cafe with rooftop; tiramisu; open until midnight on weekdays

items.title: Upper and Under
items.memo: Three-floor cafe with terraces, room for a group

items.title: Something About Coffee
items.memo: Big bakery cafe next door to Upper and Under

items.title: Sulbing Gangnam (설빙)
items.memo: Bingsu chain near Gangnam Stn exit 11; one bowl fits two; open until 22:00

items.title: CACHI Flower Cafe
items.memo: Flower-filled cafe with cakes; oat and soy milk available
